newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean 3-yr yields end lower on bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean 3-yr yields end lower on bargain hunting.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporates closed lower on Monday as institutions bought in a bargain hunting on expectations of smaller-than-expected new issues in March, brokers said.
But the overnight call rates rose after the central bank absorbed about 1.4 trillion won through repurchase agreements, they said.
* 3-yr corporates end at 12.40 pct from 12.44 on Saturday
* 3-mth CDs close at 12.40 pct unchanged from Saturday
* Overnight call average 12.10 pct from 11.30 pct
Brokers said the Bank of Korea siphoned off about 1.4 trillion won from the financial system through repurchase agreements.
"Liquidity in the short-term money market dried up after the central bank's move," said an LG Securities broker.
